catholic-encyclopedia-1913-column: This 1913 reference piece on the column — the church's classic support. Thomas Poole explains its ordered forms. The Doric stands in massive strength. The Corinthian crowns the lofty nave. The pillar of the sacred architecture. Its Trajan column is famed.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-hymn: This 1913 reference piece on the hymn — the sacred song. Clemens Blume unfolds its ancient forms. Ambrose crowned the Latin chant. The choirs sing the festal verse. The poetry of the liturgy's praise. Its 1907 studies are famed.
nasa-tm-19700023619-vibration-tolerance-: Coulometers measure electric charge — but can they survive shaking? This 1970 NASA report tests the vibration tolerance of a mercury-column coulometer. The trials showed whether the charge-measuring column keeps working after a rough ride.
the-agony-column: Earl Derr Biggers's 1916 mystery about a young American in London who answers a newspaper agony-column ad and stumbles into espionage. Romantic, witty, and suspenseful, it predates his Charlie Chan fame. Delightful early Biggers. The London setting sparkles, and the romance is as charming as the mystery.
